name: Post-Matric Tuition Fee and Examination Fee (Freeship) for SC students (Maharashtra)
provider: Social Justice and Special Assistance Department, Government of Maharashtra (via MahaDBT)

rules.quote: The parents / Guardian annual income above Rs. 250000.to unlimited.
Student category should be Scheduled caste or Neo bouddhist
Student should be resident of Maharashtra
Institute should be located in Maharashtra & shall be government recognized.

rules.value: CAP admission for professional courses; only one failure allowed
rules.quote: For Professional Courses student should admit through CAP round only

amount.text: Tuition fee, exam fee and other compulsory fees reimbursed
amount.quote: Tuition Fees, Exam Fees & other fees which are mandatory or compulsorily payable by the student to the institution are covered under the scheme.

deadline.text: Apply on MahaDBT; no date on scheme page
